invariant: A staff viewer who opens the admin page of an account with no users row is sent to the Users list with the notice, and nothing of that id is read beyond the users lookup (D85, D86)
resource: the real AdminUserProfilePage of src/app/admin/users/[id]/page.tsx with an admin-client double whose users lookup answers no row
input: AdminUserProfilePage({ params: { id: a synthetic UUID } })
response: redirect('/admin/users?notice=user_gone') once, asserted with the message 'the list, not the 404 page'
forbiddenEffects: a read of user_change_log, user_status_history or auth.admin.getUserById for that id
testName: AdminUserProfilePage [SEC-X-SRV-ADMIN-USER-GONE] a missing account opens the Users list

invariant: A staff viewer who opens the admin page of a deleted account (deleted_at set) is sent to the Users list with the notice, and none of the account's profile data is read or returned (D85, D86)
resource: the real AdminUserProfilePage with an admin-client double whose users lookup answers a synthetic row with deleted_at
input: AdminUserProfilePage({ params: { id: that row's id } })
forbiddenEffects: a read of user_change_log, user_status_history or auth.admin.getUserById for that id
the row's name or phone in a returned element
testName: AdminUserProfilePage [SEC-X-SRV-ADMIN-USER-DELETED] a deleted account opens the Users list

invariant: A failed users lookup on the admin user page shows no account data: the viewer is sent to the Users list with the notice, as for a missing account
resource: the real AdminUserProfilePage with an admin-client double whose users lookup answers { data: null, error }
input: AdminUserProfilePage({ params: { id: a synthetic UUID } }) while the lookup fails
forbiddenEffects: a read of user_change_log, user_status_history or auth.admin.getUserById for that id
testName: AdminUserProfilePage [SEC-X-SRV-ADMIN-USER-QUERY-ERROR] a failed lookup opens the Users list

invariant: The admin page of an existing, undeleted account still renders its profile for a staff viewer (preservation)
actor: an active administrator (requireStaffPage and requireViewer doubles)
resource: the real AdminUserProfilePage with an admin-client double whose users lookup answers a synthetic row without deleted_at
input: AdminUserProfilePage({ params: { id: that row's id } })
response: a returned element whose AdminUserProfile receives that row; no redirect
testName: AdminUserProfilePage [SEC-X-SRV-ADMIN-USER-PRESENT] an existing account still renders its profile

invariant: The Users list explains the redirect from a deleted user's page with the localized notice (D86)
actor: an active administrator arriving from the redirect
resource: the real AdminUsersPage and AdminPageHeader on MantineProvider with the project theme and the real en messages; AdminUsersTable is a double
response: one element with role alert whose text equals messages.en admin.pages.users_gone_notice
forbiddenEffects: the notice text in any other language
testName: AdminUsersPage [SEC-X-FE-ADMIN-USERS-NOTICE-SHOWN] the redirect notice is shown

invariant: The notice parameter selects a fixed text only: any other value shows no notice and is never rendered
actor: an administrator opening a crafted link
resource: the real AdminUsersPage and AdminPageHeader as above
input: AdminUsersPage({ searchParams: { notice: '' } }), then notice 'deleted'
response: no element with role alert, asserted with the message 'an unknown notice is not shown'; the raw value is absent from the rendered HTML
forbiddenEffects: the parameter's value in the DOM
testName: AdminUsersPage [SEC-X-FE-ADMIN-USERS-NOTICE-NOT-REFLECTED] an unknown notice is not shown

invariant: The Users list without the notice parameter renders as before, with no notice (preservation)
resource: the real AdminUsersPage and AdminPageHeader as above
response: the users_title heading and no element with role alert
testName: AdminUsersPage [SEC-X-FE-ADMIN-USERS-NOTICE-ABSENT] no notice without the parameter
